subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the configured workflow-security owners accept this grouped upgrade of 14 third-party action revisions after reviewing the exact upstream commits and refreshed privileged-workflow evidence?
rationale: The change alters code executed with repository secrets and write-capable tokens; whether each upstream action revision is acceptable is a repository trust-boundary decision, not a mechanical repair choice.

options.title: Refresh and approve the action pins
options.body: Rebase the branch, review all 14 upstream immutable revisions, and accept it only after redacted successful evidence for the relevant privileged workflow paths.

options.title: Split the privileged updates
options.body: Keep low-privilege CI action updates together but move token-, release-, and Codex-agent action upgrades into focused security-reviewed PRs.

options.title: Pause this grouped update
options.body: Close or defer the batch if the workflow-security owners do not want to accept the combined third-party execution-surface change.

recommendation.title: Refresh and approve the action pins
recommendation.body: Rebase the branch, review all 14 upstream immutable revisions, and accept it only after redacted successful evidence for the relevant privileged workflow paths.

likelyOwner.reason: This account introduced and repeatedly hardened the affected Codex-agent workflow and is the strongest feature-history routing candidate.
